verification: The archived official jeemain.nic.in question-paper page identifies all six Paper 1 PDFs below: four offline sets from 3 April and one complete online paper for each of 9 and 10 April. Every PDF was downloaded from an Internet Archive capture of that original official host, hashed, page-counted and visually rendered in full. All six files contain complete 90-question Paper 1 papers covering Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. The offline sets are in English and Hindi; the online papers are in English, Hindi and Gujarati. No worked solutions or answer key are included.
